evidence: The Alternative.me Fear & Greed Index dropped 9 points on the latest reading to 29 (Fear), down from 38 the day prior and tracking below both its 7-day mean of 35.7 and 30-day mean of 34.4. While persistent fear can occasionally lay groundwork for contrarian accumulation, a sharp single-day decline in market sentiment indicates heightened risk aversion and fragile confidence over a short 24-hour horizon. Factoring in the contract specification that a tie resolves to down, the probability of BTC closing higher over the 24-hour interval is assessed slightly below even at 0.47.
limitations: The Fear & Greed Index is a composite lagging sentiment metric rather than a real-time order book or directional pricing tool.
Index data is updated once daily and may not reflect rapid intraday sentiment shifts occurring between the prediction and target timestamps.
Snapshot availability and later revisions are caller-attested, not independently verified.
